Rationale: Project maintenance/staleness is a supply-chain risk factor (SR-3) bearing on component provenance and continued viability (SR-4).
Contributor org/nation-of-concern affiliation is a supplier assessment and review concern.
Unreviewable committed binaries are a software-integrity risk (SI-7) of unknown provenance (SR-4).
Anomalous code-change volume is a tamper/injection integrity signal (SI-7); alteration detection relates to provenance (SR-4).
Obfuscated/high-entropy commit content is an integrity-of-content signal (SI-7); alteration relates to provenance (SR-4).
Fuzz testing is a developer security testing and evaluation practice.
A pull request whose author is also its merger is a separation-of-duties gap in the change-approval path.
Peer-review-before-merge discipline is a development-process and standards practice.
Typosquatted dependencies are a component-authenticity failure (SR-11) delivering a component of false provenance (SR-4).
